_why:
NINE DECLARATIONS AT TWO SITES, AND EIGHT OF THEM ARE ONE FACT. Both sites belong to the reference's own dead code: the local `RootMyb_VelErr`, which `SUBROUTINE FlapControl` declares and no statement in ROSCO assigns, and the argument list of the `PIIController` call at Controllers.f90:670 that reads it. That call sits inside `IF (LocalVar%iStatus == 0)`, and `harness/ranges.toml` states -- from `ReadAvrSWAP`, which runs before every controller call and is the only writer of `LocalVar%restart` in the program -- that `restart == (iStatus == 0)`. So `reset` is TRUE on every admissible input that reaches that call, and PIIController's reset branch reads only `I0`, `piP` and `inst`:

    IF (reset) THEN
        piP%ITerm(inst) = I0 ; piP%ITermLast(inst) = I0
        piP%ITerm2(inst) = I0 ; piP%ITermLast2(inst) = I0
        PIIController = I0
    ELSE
        PTerm = kp*error ...

`error`, `error2`, `kp`, `ki`, `ki2`, `minValue`, `maxValue` and `DT` are dead there, on every input this domain admits AND on every input the shipped program can produce. These are (c)-class blind spots in unit #48's vocabulary -- not a corpus gap a wider draw could close.

EXECUTED, NOT ARGUED (unit #48's rule). `evidence/FlapControl/equivalence_probe.txt` counts, over the SCORED corpus, the cases that reach Controllers.f90:670 and the value of `restart` on each: 37 reach it, 37 with reset, 0 without -- a positive control that the site is live and a negative one that no case reaches the ELSE branch. The same probe confirms the stated implication holds case for case: 114 cases have `iStatus == 0` and exactly 114 have `restart` true.

SCHEMA: `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so each mid maps to its own proof. A declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR -- every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. NINE are declared and NONE is left standing, so the score is 1.000; the undeclared parts are committed beside this file (evidence/FlapControl/mutation.first_take.*.json, `equivalent_declared: 0`) so that what survived is on the record before any of it was excused.
